The spearhead is made from fossilized bones adorned with spikes, which greatly increases its stabbing power.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 15 |durability = 25 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Dragonbone Moblin Spear}} Dragonbone Moblin Spears are [[Weapon]]s favored by [[Black Moblin]]s, [[Silver Moblin]]s, and [[Golden Moblin]]s. Their spearheads are made from fossilized bones with added spikes, increasing their attack power. They belong to the [[Moblin Gear]] equipment archetype, which is a series of Weapons made by [[Moblin]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Most commonly, they can be found in [[Monster Stronghold]]s in the [[Hebra Mountains]] and [[Eldin Mountains]]. Being made of wood, Dragonbone Moblin Spears will burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or equipped in a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also float when they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Moblin Spears do not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]], and they cannot be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_012" |Life = 25 |Power = 15 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 38 |BuyingPrice = 90 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Spear }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Dragonbone Moblin Spear Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Dragonbone Moblin Spear ==See Also== {{See Also| * Moblin Gear * Moblin Spear * Spiked Moblin Spear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Moblin Gear, Spears, Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
